levels.name: Platform level: platform 1 (edge platform by the Matkakeskus), island platform 2/4, island platform 3, bus terminal side
levels.note: No signposted level name found. Väylävirasto: platform 1 (reunalaituri, 449 m) has a short step-free route from the travel centre, drop-off/parking and bus terminal; platforms 2–4 are reached via the overpass lift and stairs or the Kilpinen footbridge stairs. All four platforms 550 mm. Platform 3 (186 m) and 4 (160 m) have no passenger signage and are not in regular passenger use. Digitraffic also lists short platforms 23 and 24 (57–58 m) north-east of the station.
levels._source: Väylävirasto, "Ratapihaselvitykset: Jyväskylä" (Väyläviraston julkaisuja 53/2026, published 2026-08-10, CC BY 4.0), pp. 28 and 31–32, https://www.doria.fi/bitstream/handle/10024/195297/vj_2026-53_978-952-405-430-0.pdf?sequence=5&isAllowed=y, read 2026-10-30; Digitraffic infra-api laiturit (Väylävirasto / Fintraffic, CC BY 4.0) via /home/claude/packs_fi/FI-JY/_report.json and jyvaskyla_platform_vayla.geojson, read 2026-10-30

levels.note: OSM tags R-kioski, Picnic, Pizza Hut, Shalimar and Musta Kynnys at level 1 and one Hannikaisenkatu entrance (n13171206508) at level 1. Visit Jyväskylä puts the lockers in the main hall 'between the bus and train platform doors', which suggests the main hall opens onto the platforms; how OSM's level 1 relates to the hall is not settled. open: Level heights: no source measures them.
Visit Jyväskylä links an area map of the Matkakeskus (https://citynomadi.com/route/1dfd2d8ab5b2a662b58d9378f8afeac3, showing bus/train platforms, services, parking); not opened in this pass.
Signposted floor names and how OSM level 1 relates to the main hall: not settled (the area map and any owner floor plan were not read).
Whether Väylävirasto's 'Messusilta' and 'travel-centre overpass to Lutakko' are one structure.

Which way the Matkakeskus escalators run, and where lift n9711790489 opens: OSM only. [Lift follow-up 2026-10-30: n9711790489 (0;1) is not a platform lift: it is 10.6 m from platform 1 and 25.7 m from the JY L1 line. It lands off the platform toward the Matkakeskus. All three OSM lifts lie in the north-east part (0.79–0.87 along the JY L1 line from its south-west end), but VR places a mid-platform lift at the Tampere end. Either that lift is missing from OSM or the 'Tampere end' means something else; this is unresolved. Escalator direction is not settled.]

Platform 3 is shown in OSM with stairs from Kilpisen silta but Väylävirasto says it has no passenger signage and is not in passenger use; Digitraffic short platforms 23/24 not described by any owner text.
Picnic, Shalimar, Musta Kynnys: no own-website hours could be read (store finder blank / robots block); OSM used.
Web search budget ran out during this pass; the Matkakeskus owner/manager site (feedback link points to Granlund Manager) was not found.

answers.question: Levels' real names as signposted
answers.answer: Not settled: no source names the floors. OSM uses 0 (platforms), 0.5 (escalator landing) and 1 (shops, overpass).

answers.question: Which platforms have stairs/lifts
answers.answer: Platform 1: step-free from the Matkakeskus at ground level, plus lift and stairs from the overpass. Island 2/4: lift and stairs from the overpass (Messusilta). Island 2/3 south-west end: stairs only, from Kilpisen silta. Lifts confirmed by Väylävirasto and VR text; positions OSM only.
